description: This Java class 'DittoConnectivityCommandValidator' implements connectivity command validation logic within the Eclipse Ditto project. It intercepts various connectivity commands to validate connections and set up actor properties in an Akka actor system environment.

classes.name: DittoConnectivityCommandValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing ConnectivityCommandInterceptor that validates connectivity commands by creating client actor props and invoking connection validation, leveraging Akka actors within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: DittoConnectivityCommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with factory, actor references, connection validator, and actor system.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Overrides the method to intercept and validate specific types of connectivity commands based on their type.

methods.name: handleNullConnection
methods.description: Private method returning a Runnable that throws an IllegalStateException if the connection is null.

methods.name: resolveConnection
methods.description: Private method that resolves a Connection from a Supplier, returning an Optional<Connection>.
